# The exact `name:` of every CI job that is a REQUIRED status check on `main`
# (owner decision, 2026-08-05: all ten, previously three).
#
# THIS FILE IS A DEADLOCK TRIPWIRE. Branch protection matches a required context
# by its NAME STRING. Rename a job in ci.yml and its required context stops
# reporting forever, so every PR blocks with no way to merge the fix — the fix is
# itself a PR. `tools/check-required-contexts.py` fails the moment this file and
# `ci.yml` disagree, in either direction, which turns that deadlock into an
# ordinary red on the PR that would have caused it.
#
# Changing a job name is therefore a THREE-part change, in this order:
#   1. add the new context to branch protection (both names required for a moment)
#   2. merge the rename + this file's update
#   3. drop the old context from branch protection
# Adding a job is two parts: merge it advisory, then make it required and add the
# line here — or add both at once and accept one blocked PR while it first runs.
#
# A job that is DELIBERATELY advisory goes in ADVISORY_JOBS in the checker, with
# its reason. The list is empty on purpose: an advisory gate is one nobody has to
# obey, which is how `tier 2` — datapack load plus the whole PackTest suite — sat
# unenforced while it was believed to be blocking.
rust (fmt, clippy, test)
harness (typecheck, test)
docs (local link check)
manifest consistency (versions.toml)
prefab generators (invariants + determinism)
skin toolchain (pytest)
i18n translation tool (pytest)
mecha cross-check (PR only)
campaign storybooks (engine-version marker)
tier 2 (datapack load + PackTest)
